nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): unchecked addition wrapped with a require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): subtracts b from a after require(b <= a) underflow guard.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner function that stages the pending owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): pending owner must call to finalize the transfer and clear newOwner.
Owned constructor: initializes owner from msg.sender.
TokenNetwork constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and mints the whole supply to a hardcoded address.
ERC20 totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
ERC20 balanceOf(address): read-only lookup in balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer(address,uint): moves tokens from msg.sender to the recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve(address,uint): writes the allowance for msg.sender -> spender.
ERC20 transferFrom(address,address,uint): debits from-balance and the caller allowance, then credits the recipient.
ERC20 allowance(address,address): returns the remaining allowance.
Sets the allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract in the same transaction.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer.
Owned.owner: privileged address controlling onlyOwner functions.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner staged until acceptOwnership is called.
TokenNetwork.symbol public token ticker.
TokenNetwork.name public token name.
TokenNetwork.decimals public value; set to 0 in the constructor.
TokenNetwork._totalSupply: stored total supply used by totalSupply().
TokenNetwork.balances mapping(address => uint) holding all account balances.
TokenNetwork.allowed nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding allowances.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authentication and balance indexing.
Unchecked integer addition c = a + b inside safeAdd.
Unchecked integer subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub.
Unchecked integer multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul.
Unchecked integer division c = a / b inside safeDiv.
Arithmetic expression _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().
Balance debit balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) in transfer().
Balance credit balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transfer().
Balance debit balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) in transferFrom().
Allowance debit allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) in transferFrom().
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance is written.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied contract address.
Access-control gate require(msg.sender == owner) enforced by the onlyOwner modifier.
Access-control gate require(msg.sender == newOwner) inside acceptOwnership().

edges.reason: Owner is derived directly from the untrusted msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before running transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller fully controls which balance is moved.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller identity.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller identity.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
msg.sender indexes the balance being debited in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping being debited in transferFrom.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check of transferOwnership.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check of transferAnyERC20Token.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
transferOwnership writes the staged pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership authenticates against and then clears newOwner.

transfer reads and writes balances for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for from and to.

safeAdd performs the raw addition guarded only by a revert check.
safeSub performs the raw subtraction guarded only by a revert check.
safeMul performs the raw multiplication guarded only by a revert check.
safeDiv performs the raw division guarded only by a revert check.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without SafeMath.
transfer debits the caller balance through the subtraction helper.
transfer credits the recipient balance through the addition helper.
transferFrom debits the from balance through the subtraction helper.
transferFrom debits the caller allowance through the subtraction helper.
approveAndCall hands control to the spender contract via receiveApproval before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary tokenAddress contract that can re-enter.
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner require on msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token is protected by the onlyOwner require on msg.sender.
acceptOwnership enforces require(msg.sender == newOwner).
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the from balance and the allowance debit.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
